mat {{version}}
> Render a Markdown file the way GitHub does and open it in your browser.

ARGUMENTS:
  [file.md] - The file to render, or - to read stdin. Default: the first of index.md, README.md, docs/index.md, docs/README.md, SPEC.md that exists here. [optional]

OPTIONS:
  --output <path>  - Write the self-contained HTML there and open no browser. - is stdout. [optional]
  --theme <name>   - auto, light or dark. Default: auto. [optional]
  --flavor <name>  - Markdown dialect. Default: gfm. [optional]
  --base-dir <dir> - Directory relative links resolve against, only valid with -. Default: the current directory. [optional]

FLAGS:
  --help, -h    - show help [optional]
  --version, -v - print the version [optional]

EXAMPLES:

  Render a file and open it in the browser
  $ mat README.md

  Render this directory's first standard document
  $ mat

  Read the document from stdin
  $ cat notes.md | mat -

  Write a self-contained file and open nothing
  $ mat README.md --output readme.html
